_about: Public-domain William Herbert Perry Faunce (1859-1930), Baptist minister and president of Brown University, for the Word Hoard: The Two Bands, a Seamen's Friend Society sermon, The Educational Ideal in the Ministry, What does Christianity Mean?, The Social Aspects of Foreign Missions, Religion and War, and The New Horizon of State and Church. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 99 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
